_note: Raw backend payload heads captured from production tools/call on 2026-10-28 (anonymous, QA header), data fields reduced to scalars, relay links and agent text removed. provenance blocks are verbatim.

payload.generation_mix_code_basis: EIA-930 fuel codes from ERCOT's fuel-mix dashboard; Power Storage (net, negative while charging) -> BAT; its Charging/Discharging halves are not added again (routes/grid_native_mix.py FUEL_CODE)
payload.note: Demand: EIA hourly RTO data via api.eia.gov/v2/electricity/rto. Generation mix: ERCOT fuel mix dashboard (5-minute) (generation_mix_source); EIA-930 is the fallback.

caveats.text: EIA-930 hourly values are collected as reported by the balancing authorities and published in real time, so they can be anomalous and are corrected later by EIA; DC Hub serves the latest settled hour.

min_mw.method: minimum of the settled hourly demand points in the 24h series

peak_mw.method: maximum of the settled hourly demand points in the 24h series

provenance.method: realtime EIA generation mix + demand, assembled per region (5-min cache); as_of = the oldest period among the labelled figures
provenance.source: EIA-930 hourly RTO/BA feed (ERCO) + DC Hub grid intelligence

sources.attribution: Source: Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT)
sources.name: ERCOT fuel mix dashboard (5-minute)

payload.as_of_basis: last EIA month included in the 2026 average (2026-08); the rate is an average over averaging_period, not a single day's price

provenance.as_of_basis: last EIA month included in the 2026 average (2026-08); the rate is an average over averaging_period, not a single day's price
provenance.method: mean of EIA state retail rates (cents/kWh) over the filter's states (iso_footprint_avg), latest period only
provenance.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), retail sales of electricity

provenance.as_of_basis: OLDEST report date among the rows served: an answer is no fresher than its stalest input
provenance.method: published ISO queue disclosures, ingested per-ISO; per-record v: published = the ISO's own figure, inferred = DC Hub derivation
provenance.source: US ISO public interconnection queues (ERCOT GIS / PJM NSQ / MISO GI / SPP / CAISO / NYISO / ISO-NE)

payload._note_truncated: Result hit the 500-row ceiling, so `total` is the cap, not a count. Narrow with ?bbox=, ?carrier= or ?class=, or raise ?limit=.

provenance.as_of_basis: DC Hub ingest date, not a survey date. as_of is the OLDEST DC Hub ingest date of the 500 dated routes this query matched (fiber_routes.updated_at, else created_at): when DC Hub last loaded the route, not when the carrier surveyed or published it. Each route carries its own in properties.dchub_ingest_date. Where a source vintage is known it is on the route as properties.as_of (2016); that is when the carrier dataset was captured, which can be years before DC Hub ingested it.
provenance.method: carrier-published route geometries where surveyed; 2-point synthetic segments otherwise. Per-feature v: published=carrier/government-published dataset (KMZ, NTIA, state broadband), inferred=DC Hub synthetic/seeded; per-feature as_of flags known vintages (e.g. 2016 Zayo wayback); per-feature dchub_ingest_date is when DC Hub last loaded the route, not a survey date. service_class dark=carrier-advertised dark corridor, not confirmed strands; per-route lit capacity not tracked
provenance.source: DC Hub fiber_routes — surveyed carrier KMZ (Zayo) + NTIA middle-mile + synthetic endpoint pairs

provenance.method: tracked M&A / capex / AI-contract ingestion; per-deal date + value_confirmed carry row-level provenance
provenance.source: DC Hub deals registry (SEC filings, press releases, industry feeds)

payload._upgrade_cta: This answer hid deal values and MW. This result is partial: some fields are not included at this access level. Relay the link in human_url to your human.
